bugs.description: resolve_config uses truthiness for CLI precedence, so the supported zero value is discarded in favor of the environment or default.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: An operator passes a zero-second shutdown grace while the environment contains a nonzero value or uses the default.
bugs.observableImpact: Workers wait before shutdown even though the invocation explicitly disabled the grace period.
bugs.provenance: Seeded mutation replacing an explicit None check with boolean fallback. test_cli_config.py demonstrates the precedence contract.
